items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How would he sound playing an ordinary march, sir? Mayor Perez. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they'd play marches by music, see.

ctx.x: How would he sound playing an ordinary march, sir? Mayor Perez. Sound pretty much the same way. Are you on a march or a funeral march? Regular march. Well, regular march. Well, it's not so hard on it, marches. Yeah. But he'd play it pretty much what? Would he play?
Yeah, they'd play marches by music, see. Straight, straight music. Yeah, they'd play marches by that music. Well, how would he sound, say, if they were playing a jazz tune in the street?
